# Business Manifesting

> Business Manifesting is where manifesting meets performance science. Founded by Rola Diab, it blends spiritual practices with performance science to help founders, business owners, executives and their teams grow. The work is built on The Conviction Code™.

Business Manifesting is part of Alor Solutions (https://alorsolutions.com/).

## Programs

- [1:1 and group coaching](https://businessmanifesting.com/coaching/apply/): Apply for coaching with Rola Diab. Qualified applicants book a 45-minute Performance Strategy Session.
- [Group coaching](https://businessmanifesting.com/coaching/group/): Virtual group coaching for founders, business owners and leaders.
- [For teams](https://businessmanifesting.com/work-with-us/): Sales and leadership training for teams, as one-to-one or group coaching.

## Digital products

- [All digital products](https://businessmanifesting.com/products/): Guided practices and tools to use on your own time.
- [The CLEAR Method™](https://businessmanifesting.com/products/clear-method/): Clear the limiting beliefs blocking success, starting from where each belief sits in the body.
- [The Conviction Code™](https://businessmanifesting.com/products/conviction-code/): A 9-week program for founders and leaders to build conviction in 15 minutes a day.
- [Ground & Clear](https://businessmanifesting.com/products/ground-and-clear/): A daily 15-minute practice to clear absorbed stress and moods.
- [Get Over Your Ex](https://businessmanifesting.com/products/get-over-your-ex/): A guided process to move on in as little as 45 minutes.

## Live events

- [Group Manifesting Live](https://businessmanifesting.com/live/): A free monthly live manifesting session on Zoom.
- [The Business Manifesting Summit](https://businessmanifesting.com/summit/): A live and virtual summit for founders, executives and leaders.

## Free assessment

- [Performance Profile](https://quiz.convictioncode.com/): A free assessment from The Conviction Code.
